serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Saviynt delivers cloud-based Identity Governance, privileged access management and a Cloud Security solution. Saviynt enables organizations to automate the access lifecycle of employees, contractors, and customers. Saviynt provides seamless visibility and compliance across applications, data and infrastructure for Hybrid IT. Saviynt also helps protect organization’s cloud infrastructure and SaaS solutions from internal and external risks with Privileged Access Management (PAM).
Saviynt provides a single pane of glass view to manage users’ access across data, infrastructure and applications that reside on Cloud and Enterprise. Saviynt combines intelligent IGA (Identity Governance and Administration) and PAM processes with usage and risk analytics.
